## Further information
- To receive the Age Pension, you must also meet the Services Australia (Centrelink) [eligibility criteria](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/age-pension).

results.title: The Age Pension | Cbus Super
results.description:
# The Age Pension
## How the Age Pension works
### Super and the Age Pension
##### Chapter 2: Eligibility
First, you must have reached age 67.

You also need to be an Australian resident for at least 10 years, including five continuous years.

CBUS also offers Age Pension calculators that can help estimate what you might receive.

## Do your income and assets meet the eligibility criteria?
### Age Pension eligibility calculators
Don't miss out on the Government benefits you deserve.

**If you’re under 66**

Find out what your income might be from super and the Age Pension after you retire, with the [Retirement income calculator](https://www.cbussuper.com.au/tools-resources/calculators/retirement-income-estimate-calculator).

**If you’re 66 or over**

Find out how much Age Pension you might get and when you may be able to claim it, with the [Age Pension calculator](https://www.cbussuper.com.au/redirects/cbus-tools-resources-calculators-age-pension-calculator).
